items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And this is Harrison from Cross River. Harrison Barnes. Yeah, he's back in there. I know him.

ctx.x: It's a little boy. It's a little boy.

It's a little boy. Well that's me right there. Yeah. Yeah. And this is, right in here is another Eddie Johnson. Big, we always call him big on any kind of these two. Both of them have the same name. We call him Big Eddie Johnson. We call him Little Eddie Johnson. And this is Harrison from Cross River. Harrison Barnes. Yeah, he's back in there. I know him. Yeah. Syndicate. And right back in there is Otto Ark Alexander. Oh yes. Tats then. Yeah, that's right. Now here's a fellow, I can't call his name. I couldn't…
